title: Every direct import is declared in a group that ships it
note: D-2026-74. The check reads pyproject.toml rather than the environment, because CI installs every group and so cannot see a package that arrives only transitively. Each mutation weakens one rule, the scope, or the inventory derivation.

mutations.name: DD1_a_guarded_import_counts_as_eager_never
mutations.find:
elif isinstance(node, ast.Try) and child in node.body \
                    and _guarded(node.handlers):
                e = False
mutations.replace:
elif isinstance(node, ast.Try) and child in node.body:
                e = False
mutations.rationale: any try guards an import, whatever it catches: a try/except KeyError would hide an eager import
